name: Halder
title: Novice Master
flavor_intro: Halder chalks a circle on the stone and motions you inside.
flavor_loss: Halder steps back. "Heal up. Earn your next breath."

name: Barak
title: Iron Coach
flavor_intro: Barak rolls his shoulders. "No cheering in this hall. Only steel."
flavor_win: Barak spits blood and grins. "Good. You're less soft now."
flavor_loss: Barak shakes his head. "You came loud and left broken."

name: Aladdin
title: Sandblade Mentor
flavor_intro: Aladdin's curved blade flashes once. "Show me footwork worth teaching."
flavor_loss: Aladdin lowers his blade. "You chased speed and forgot control."

name: Candle
title: Master of Ember Forms
flavor_intro: Candle snuffs the torches until only one ember burns between you.
flavor_win: Candle relights the hall. "Your discipline held."
flavor_loss: Candle turns away. "You burned hot, then died cold."

name: Prince Caspian
title: Silver Banner Master
flavor_intro: Prince Caspian draws and salutes. "By honor and edge, begin."
flavor_win: Caspian's blade lowers. "You carried the banner well."
flavor_loss: Caspian bows once. "Title means nothing without resolve."

name: Sparhawk
title: Veteran of Seven Wars
flavor_intro: Sparhawk studies your eyes, not your weapon. "War starts there."
flavor_win: Sparhawk clasps your shoulder. "You've seen enough pain to learn from it."
flavor_loss: Sparhawk sighs. "Battle would swallow you whole right now."

name: Atsuko Sensei
title: Storm Discipline
flavor_intro: Atsuko bows and the gallery falls silent.
flavor_win: Atsuko returns your bow. "Calm mind. Killing edge. Advance."
flavor_loss: Atsuko closes her eyes. "You fought the storm instead of becoming it."

name: Aragorn
title: Ranger-King Instructor
flavor_intro: Aragorn circles once. "Stand like the last wall before darkness."
flavor_win: Aragorn nods. "You are fit for harsher roads."
flavor_loss: Aragorn points at your stance. "One gap is enough to bury a kingdom."

name: Borin
title: Anvil Champion
flavor_intro: Borin slams his hammer haft on stone. "Let's hear your spine ring true."
flavor_win: Borin laughs like thunder. "Aye. That's iron in your bones."
flavor_loss: Borin spits. "The anvil outlasted you. Again."

name: Eldria
title: Moonsteel Grandmaster
flavor_intro: Eldria's moonsteel hums. "Try not to blink at your own ending."
flavor_win: Eldria sheaths her blade. "You have earned champion's rank."
flavor_loss: Eldria's gaze is cold. "Pretty effort. Fatal openings."

name: Turgon
title: Hallmaster of Honor
flavor_intro: Turgon enters the ring barehanded, then nods for you to strike first.
flavor_win: Turgon salutes. "Go. The Dragon is your master now."
flavor_loss: Turgon turns from the ring. "Not dragon-ready. Not yet."
